Insights

What twelve seasons of college lacrosse data show.

Where players come from, who gets on the field, and who college programs overlook. Each finding comes with the data behind it, and a link to check your own town or program.

25 Sep 2026

The top 10 skip Ohio and Georgia. Their players hold their own.

The best women's programs take half as many players from Ohio and Georgia as the programs next door. Measured against their own teammates, those players play just as much — the same quality, with less competition for it.

Women's · For coaches
25 Sep 2026

Massapequa or Islip? A town's record is mostly luck.

One Long Island town's D1 players start; another's sit. Shuffle every player's hometown at random and towns like both appear anyway. A town needs about 100 players before its record is half signal.

Men's · For coaches and families
24 Sep 2026

Canada is the most under-recruited source in men's college lacrosse.

Per roster spot, Ontario produces more All-Americans than any US state, and Canadian players start more and sit less. They fill one Division I roster spot in twenty.
